title: 2570 do not list all assets for perception

issues.title: Reduce time to load interactions with lots of entities
issues.body:
In ISTAR interaction involves hundreds of assets.

It takes several minutes to load, with the browser wanting to time out.

For these interactions - inject the related assets, but not the full remaining list.

Do this in the adjud message list page's `localCustomiseAssets`. But, also remove the call to `SupportPanel`.`customiseTemplates` - since that already collates the asset list.  Insert the relevant customisers into `adjud message list` page.
